channel.title: Bryan County News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bryan County News (bryancountynews.com)

item.title: BankSouth opens branch at Hyundai's Metaplant
item.description: ELLABELL – Workers at Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America can now do their personal banking while at work as the metaplant oversaw the grand opening of its new on-site banking branch Thursday.

item.title: Bryan County Schools superintendent announces retirement
item.description: Dr. Paul Brooksher has announced that he will step down from his position as superintendent of Bryan County Schools and retire at the end of the 2025-26 school year.

item.title: Injured Evans inspired by dad's example
item.description: Roughly six years ago, Richmond Hill’s Faith Evans decided to play basketball, a sport in which she watched her father, Robert, play with determination and desire.

item.title: Wildcats face tight push to playoffs
item.description: There’s a fine line between winning and losing, as the Richmond Hill’s boys’ basketball team is learning this season.

item.title: Bryan County back to winning ways with 59-18 win over Savannah
item.description: Bryan County’s girls showed no ill effects of a 63-42 thumping at Region 3A-DII leader Metter when they took on winless Savannah last Friday night at home.

item.title: Redskins post 72-65 win over visitors Savannah on Friday
item.description: Admittedly Savannah High is not the same team which won the Class A-DII state basketball championship last year but any time you can beat the Blue Jackets it’s a feather in your cap.

item.title: Recap: Bryan County 44, Screven County 50
item.description: Bryan County’s girls fell behind early and spent the rest of the night playing catch up Tuesday night at Screven County as they dropped a 50-44 Region 3A-DII matchup. The loss came on the heels of a 41-point (59-18) win over Savannah High four nights earlier.

item.title: Richmond Hill seniors recount their paths to wrestling
item.description: Both seniors Isla Stotts and Coralys Lopez both began their wrestling career at Richmond Hill on an afterthought.

item.title: Shell Out for a CURE Oyster Roast to support local children battling cancer
item.description: CURE Childhood Cancer, an organization dedicated to conquering the disease through funding targeted research and supporting patients and their families, will host its annual Shell Out for a CURE on Friday, Feb. 6. The signature oyster roast fundraiser will take place at Belhaven in Richmond Hill.

item.title: Westwin town hall set for Monday
item.description: Westwin Elements is set to host a town hall on Monday, Feb. 2 at the Richmond Hill City Center in a bid to allay fears held by Bryan County residents regarding the company’s plans to establish a nickel refinery in Richmond Hill.
